figures.label: Figure 1

caption.text: Figure 1. An illustration of safe exploration with conformal policy control. Starting with a safe policy π0 and safe context prompts X0 := {x1, . . . , xm }, we observe the safe policy’s actions ai and corresponding reward ri ∈ R and constraint violation ℓi ∈ {0, 1}. We split the observations into train and calibration data, and optimize the safe policy to obtain πt . We then query the user for their constraint violation risk tolerance α, and apply conformal risk control to find a bound on the likelihood ratio πt /π0 which guarantees the calibrated risk is controlled at level α. Finally we apply rejection sampling to probabilistically regulate the optimized policy for deployment and observation, allowing the user to flexibly trade off reward, constraint risk, and test-time compute.

figures.label: Figure 5

caption.text: Figure 5. Conformal policy control in the active learning setting. We train Gaussian process regression models on tabular datasets, providing a small amount of initial data for training and selecting the remaining training data via exponential tilting toward the posterior predictive variance. We introduce a feasibility constraint based on alignment with the leading principal component of the Gram matrix to make the task more difficult. CPC controls the constraint violation risk at our desired threshold α = 0.2, while simultaneously reducing test MSE. Surprisingly, in some cases the risk-controlled data selection policy attains lower test MSE than the uncontrolled policy.

figures.label: Figure 8

caption.text: Figure 8. Empirical evaluation of a recent Constrained Bayesian Optimization (CBO) method (Tian et al., 2024) with CPC (blue) and without CPC (red) over various acquisition sampling temperature settings. Results: Across temperature settings of 2.0 (left column), 1.0 (middle column), and 0.1 (right column), the CPC-controlled CBO method controls the constraint violation rate below the target level of alpha=0.4 (blue, top row). In contrast, the standard CBO baseline has much higher constraint violation rates above alpha=0.4; the baseline’s violation rate in early policy improvement rounds appears to slightly decrease with reduced sampling temperatures (red, top row), but not as a function of alpha, so hyperparameter tuning would be required to find an acceptable temperature value (if one exists). The CPC+CBO method attains comparable or slightly improved reward over the CBO baseline without CPC across settings (bottom row), possibly due to wasting fewer evaluations on infeasible samples.

caption.text: Figure 11. Supplementary experimental results applying CPC to constrained black-box optimization of token sequences scored with Ehrlich functions. In the left panel, we show the average feasibility rate round-over-round. cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1 先给 CPC pipeline；Figure 2 建立 synthetic non-monotonic risk 动机；Figure 3 展示 β-family/AR；Figures 4–6 依次给 factuality、active learning、sequence 主结果；Figures 7–11 在附录补充 CBO setup/comparison、calibration decomposition、score robustness 与 alpha sweep。Table 1 定位边界，Tables 2–5 负责复现参数。
cross_object_system.caption_system: 统一使用 italic Figure/Table label 与 sentence-case caption；结果图常用 Left/Center/Right 或 row/column cues。Figure 4/10 明确定义 standard-error regions，Figure 5/6/8/11 对 seed、分母和 ribbon 统计量说明不足。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: Table 1 使用三层 capability header；Tables 2–5 使用 Parameter/Symbol/Value 或 Hyperparameter/Value。附录表保持 booktabs、无竖线与一致的 CMR/Nimbus Roman 外观。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: Figure 1/3/9 是 method interface/theory mechanism；Figure 2/4/10 支撑 gCRC mechanism/result；Figure 5/6/8/11 支撑 CPC result、risk–utility 与 robustness。PDF 没有 component deletion ablation，multiple α、score source 和 temperature 属于 sensitivity/robustness。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: 正文将 Figure 3 连接 Appendix D、Figure 6 连接 Appendix G，并将 CBO 第四设置连接 Appendix B；Figure 4→Figure 10、Figure 5→Table 3、Figure 6→Figure 11 由标题和章节调用完成。证明与实现近似仍需 Appendix C/D。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 正文/附录 caption/body 主要为 Nimbus Roman No9 L 与 Computer Modern math；图内 axes 多为 DejaVu Sans。附录宽图维持同一 family，但 long legends 和 source-size scaling 使实际阅读密度不同。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: CPC/gCRC blue、safe/Gaussian teal、uncontrolled/test red 在多个对象复用；baseline green/brown/olive 随任务变化。Figure 11 的多-alpha color mapping 与 Figure 6 不完全一致，颜色数量高时灰度可读性下降。
